newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sipa bids A$7.8 mln for Mt King Mining.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sipa bids A$7.8 mln for Mt King Mining.

text.p: Gold explorer Sipa Resources International NL said on Thursday it planned a takeover bid for unlisted miner Mt King Mining which valued the company at A$7.8 million.
It said it also planned to issue 30 million Sipa shares to raise A$10 million.
Mt King has a 25.5 percent stake in the Dublin Hill mine in Western Australia which is due to reduce to 15 percent.
"Sipa intends to offer (by way of a takeover scheme) 50 cents cash or alternatively one Sipa share for every one Mount King share," it said.
Mt King was proceeding with a share buyback and cancellation of 4.875 million of its shares for nil consideration.

Sipa said it would increase its bid by 22 cents per Mt King share if the buyback and cancellation was approved before January 31. The scrip option would increase by three Sipa shares for every seven Mount King shares.

Sipa will offer to by Mt King options at 30 cents per option, with an incremental increase in the consideration of 22 cents per option payable in the event that the proposed share buyback is approved and entered into as set out above.

"The takeover offers will be conditional on Foreign Investment Review Board approval, the approval of Sipa shareholders...of the proposed placement of 30 million Sipa shares, receipt by Sipa of at least A$10 million from that placement and prescribed occurrences."
Sipa already has a 15.1 percent stake in Mt King.
Sipa's shares were unchanged at 52 cents at 10.50 am (2350 GMT).
